Joins Montgomery tracts to EPA facility counts (coalesced to zero) and CDC adult asthma prevalence, computes facilities per 1,000 totalpopulation, and returns each paired tract with the overall correlation and paired-tract count as window functions, ranked by the facility rate.
sql:
WITH fac AS (
  SELECT geoid, CAST(n AS DOUBLE) AS fac_count
  FROM fw_pg.tract_counts
  WHERE run_id = 'r_20261025_f5b9ce' AND source = 'm1_cdc' AND grp = 'all'
),
health AS (
  SELECT tractfips AS geoid,
         CAST(totalpopulation AS DOUBLE) AS totalpopulation,
         CAST(casthma_crudeprev AS DOUBLE) AS adult_asthma_prevalence_pct
  FROM session.fw_f5b9ce_m2_cdc
  WHERE casthma_crudeprev IS NOT NULL
),
paired AS (
  SELECT t.geoid, t.name,
         COALESCE(f.fac_count, 0) AS fac_count,
         h.totalpopulation,
         h.adult_asthma_prevalence_pct,
         CASE WHEN h.totalpopulation IS NOT NULL AND h.totalpopulation > 0
              THEN COALESCE(f.fac_count, 0) / h.totalpopulation * 1000.0
         END AS epa_facilities_per_1000_totalpopulation
  FROM fw_pg.tracts t
  LEFT JOIN fac f ON f.geoid = t.geoid
  JOIN health h ON h.geoid = t.geoid
)
SELECT name,
       epa_facilities_per_1000_totalpopulation,
       fac_count,
       totalpopulation,
       adult_asthma_prevalence_pct,
       CORR(epa_facilities_per_1000_totalpopulation, adult_asthma_prevalence_pct) OVER () AS corr_epa_facilities_per_1000_residents_vs_adult_asthma_prevalence,
       COUNT(*) OVER () AS paired_tracts,
       geoid
FROM paired
WHERE epa_facilities_per_1000_totalpopulation IS NOT NULL
  AND adult_asthma_prevalence_pct IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY epa_facilities_per_1000_totalpopulation DESC NULLS LAST, name ASC
LIMIT 200
